prior_art_status: Substantial close prior art found: MIRRAMS (arXiv:2507.08280) directly targets unseen missingness shifts; NeuMiss and impute-then-regress (arXiv:2106.00311); mechanism-dependent robustness analysis (arXiv:2406.16484). This is not an exhaustive novelty review.
limitations: The practical validation screen failed: candidate mean AP was 0.00448 below the strongest matched validation control, though clean AP stayed within the allowed decrease.

On final data, candidate was 0.00102 AP below completed-plus-augmentation without weights, below the preregistered 0.005 utility threshold. Positive comparison against mean imputation is a weak-control result.
ADMIB exceeded the unaugmented completion arm by 0.00568 AP on final conditions, but this does not override the failed validation screen and matched augmented control result.
Only three synthetic fixture seeds were used; external data and deployment behavior are untested.
The four-class propensity weighting is a finite implementation of the proposal, but cannot guarantee conditional independence of masks and labels after lossy imputation.
NeuMiss was cited but not implemented as a control; no claim is made to outperform it.
